notes: Ruled the Songhai Empire from 1493 until his deposition in 1528.
Conventionally dated as king of Sukhothai from about 1279 until about 1298; the chronology is traditional and approximate.
Served as Abbasid caliph from 786 until his death in 809.

role: Daimyo and de facto national leader
notes: Dominated central Japanese politics from his entry into Kyoto in 1568 until his death in the Honnō-ji Incident in 1582.
Reigned as king of the Neo-Babylonian Empire from 605 to 562 BCE.
Conventionally dated as king of Denmark from about 958 until about 986; exact accession and death dates remain uncertain.
Reigned as the fourth king of Joseon from 1418 until his death in 1450.
Reigned as emperor of Ethiopia from 1930 until his deposition in 1974, excluding the Italian occupation period when he was in exile.
Ruled the Huns jointly from 434 and alone after about 445 until his death in 453.
Reigned as Saadi sultan of Morocco from 1578 until his death in 1603.
Served as doge of Venice from 1192 until his death in 1205.
Exercised personal rule as emperor of Brazil from the declaration of majority in 1840 until the monarchy was overthrown in 1889.
Reigned as king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 669 until about 631 BCE; older chronologies sometimes extended his reign to 627 BCE.
Served as mahapatih of Majapahit from about 1331 until his death in 1364.
Reigned as queen of Portugal from 1777 until her death in 1816.
Reigned as king of Poland from 1333 until his death in 1370.
